g.text: Inside one CTA: one row (D = 2048), 256 threads. Same in both grids.
Thread i loads gate[8i .. 8i+7] and up[8i .. 8i+7]: two 16 B loads.
g = min(gate, 10), u = clamp(up, -10, 10) in bf16
v = g / (1 + exp(-g)) * u in fp32
group of 128 outputs = 16 threads (half a warp):
absmax = shuffle-max of m over the 16 lanes
q row [2048] fp8 = 2 KB, 16 scales (one per group)
Both grids run this same math on each row. They differ only in which CTA runs which row.
